PEP: 101
Title: Phrase Fixture Number 101
Author: A. Author <a@example.org>
Status: Final

Abstract
========

This PEP replaces :pep:`100` with effect from 1 March 2011.

This PEP supplements rather than supersedes PEP 102. If accepted, this PEP
would *supersede* :pep:`103`. PEP 104 is in danger of being superseded.
